fields.place: Born near Rāmabhadrācala (Godāvarī); Galtā near Jaipur (ācārya)
fields.notes: A Rāmānandī Vaiṣṇava, author of the Bhaktamāla. Born blind in the «Lākhabhakta» family of singers near Rāmabhadrācala; abandoned in a famine; Kīlhadāsa gave him sight and Agradāsa (#22) dīkṣā and the name Nārāyaṇadāsa, and installed him as ācārya at Galtā.

fields.appearance: About the mid-17th century (the record's text)
fields.works: Commentaries on Kirāta, Kumāra, Ghaṭakarpara, Naiṣadha, Nalodaya, Amarakoṣa, Bhaṭṭi, Meghadūta, Śiśupāla; Candraprabhā; Ratnaprabhā; Kārakollāsa; Subodhā ṭīkā on the Gīta-govinda; Drutabodha with Drutabodhinī; Ratna-kaumudī; Sāra-kaumudī
fields.notes: A vaidya scholar (Mahāmahopādhyāya) of the mid-17th century: commentaries on the great kāvyas and the Amarakoṣa, grammar (Drutabodha, Kārakollāsa in the manner of Jīva's Harināmāmṛta-vyākaraṇa), Āyurveda, and a Subodhā ṭīkā on the Gīta-govinda praised for its depth of rasa.

name: Vaiṣṇava Dāsa Bābājī Mahāśaya Of Kosi

fields.name: Vaiṣṇava dāsa Bābājī (Kosī)
fields.aka: Vaiṣṇava Dāsa Bābājī Mahāśaya Of Kosi, Vaiṣṇava dāsa bābājī
fields.place: Kosī (Vraja): under the trees; the Rādhā-Govinda temple built by the King of Jodhpur
fields.notes: A Gauḍīya bābājī of Kosī, contemporary of Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa of Kāmyavana; lived under trees with an iron fire-tongs; by his word Pūrṇānanda Gosvāmī of Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa had three sons (Nṛsiṁhānanda, Premānanda #1115, Yādavānanda); the King of Jodhpur built the Rādhā-Govinda temple of Kosī at his request. Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana bowed down to him (Advaita dāsa Bābājī).
